d: In this video, Firstpost Explains what TIME's latest global airline rankings reveal about the world's best carriers for 2027. Dubai-based Emirates has claimed the top spot, followed by Qatar Airways and Air New Zealand. Indian airlines have missed out on the overall top 100, but IndiGo has secured sixth place among the world's most reliable airlines, while Air India Express ranks 37th. The rankings assess passenger experience and operational performance, using surveys and data from more than 30 million flights. What do these results say about Indian aviation?
